title: Yellow Peruvian Sausages Grill
description: Spicy, light, post-workout Peruvian dish featuring sausages, confit-tomato, and satvik-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes (2)
ingredients.notes: Any color, but yellow or orange for traditional color

instructions: Brush the grates with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the sausages for 5 minutes per side, or until nicely charred.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin and smoked paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the confit with salt and black pepper to taste.
Once the sausages are cooked, let them rest for 2 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced sausages with the confit tomato and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
